name: NEMA 1-15
description: North American 2-pole, 2-wire non-grounding plug and receptacle rated 15 A, 125 V: two flat parallel blades, the neutral blade wider on polarised plugs. A 1-15P plug also fits the grounding NEMA 5-15R receptacle.

standards.title: Plugs and socket-outlets for domestic and similar general use standardized in member countries of IEC
standards.scope: Catalogue of national plug and socket-outlet systems

relations.note: NEMA 5-15 adds a ground pin to the same blade layout; 1-15P plugs fit 5-15R receptacles.

variants.name: NEMA 1-15P plug
variants.keying: Polarised plugs have a wider neutral blade; unpolarised plugs have two equal blades and fit either way.
mechanicalNotes: Blades 6.4 mm wide, 1.5 mm thick, 15.9–18.3 mm long, 12.7 mm between centres.
On polarised plugs the neutral blade is 7.9 mm wide.

matesWith.note: A polarised plug does not fit an unpolarised receptacle.
Polarised and unpolarised 1-15P plugs fit; the ground hole stays unused.

variants.name: NEMA 1-15R receptacle
variants.keying: Polarised receptacles have a wider neutral slot; older ones have two equal slots.
mechanicalNotes: Not allowed in new construction in the United States and Canada since 1962; still found in older buildings and sold for replacement.

electricalProfiles.name: AC single-phase
conditions: The rating comes from secondary sources; ANSI/NEMA WD 6 was not reviewed.
On unpolarised plugs line and neutral can be on either blade.

sources.title: NEMA connector
sources.note: Secondary source: rating, blade dimensions, polarisation, 1962 restriction.

sources.title: AC power plugs and sockets
sources.note: Secondary source: NEMA 1 rated 15 A at 125 V.
